label: Chapter 29
english: Our holy teacher, who was greatly experienced in asceticism (praktikotatos) said, ‘The monk must always be ready as though he were to die tomorrow, but he must as well treat his body as if he were going to live with it for many years. The first [approach] cuts off the thoughts of acedia and makes the monk more zealous, while the second maintains the body and keeps its self-control in balance.’
